mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_sale_item ( sale_record_id, product_id, batch_id, purchase_id, purchase_item_id, quantity, sale_unit_price, sale_amount, cost_unit_price, cost_amount, profit_amount, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{saleRecordId}, #{productId}, #{batchId}, #{purchaseId}, #{purchaseItemId}, #{quantity}, #{saleUnitPrice}, #{saleAmount}, #{costUnitPrice}, #{costAmount}, #{profitAmount}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT si.id, si.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, pt.type_name AS product_type_name, p.brand, p.model, pi.device_no, pi.condition_desc, si.batch_id, b.batch_no, si.purchase_id, si.purchase_item_id, pu.purchase_no, si.quantity, si.sale_unit_price, si.sale_amount, si.cost_unit_price, si.cost_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sr.total_sale_amount, 0) = 0 THEN si.profit_amount ELSE ROUND( si.sale_amount - si.cost_amount - ( COALESCE(sr.platform_fee, 0) + COALESCE(sr.express_fee, 0) + COALESCE(sr.package_fee, 0) + COALESCE(sr.promotion_fee, 0) + COALESCE(sr.other_expense, 0) + COALESCE(sr.refund_amount, 0) ) * si.sale_amount / sr.total_sale_amount, 2 ) END AS profit_amount, si.remark FROM biz_sale_item si INNER JOIN biz_sale_record sr ON sr.id = si.sale_record_id AND sr.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product_type pt ON pt.id = p.product_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN biz_inventory_batch b ON b.id = si.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN biz_purchase pu ON pu.id = si.purchase_id AND pu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_purchase_item pi ON pi.id = si.purchase_item_id AND pi.deleted = 0 WHERE si.sale_record_id = #{saleRecordId} AND si.deleted = 0 ORDER BY si.id ASC
